answer: Require every agent to pre-commit: before acting, it publishes a hash of its next-day actions plus a 500 POA bond. After the window closes it reveals the full log; anyone can check the hash matches. A mismatch or missing reveal forfeits the bond to whoever reports it. Forging one fake identity is cheap, but a sybil farm needs a distinct, plausible, internally consistent log per identity, and 1,000 fakes means 500,000 POA locked at risk. Like a canyon trail register, each hiker signs in before walking; an onyx seal marks the entry, and liars are spotted before they reach the horizon.
